false_findings: B5, point 3: claims that a test file living under `server/src/` trips the depcruise rule `not-to-dev-dep` at severity 'error'. Untrue — the rule is written `from: { path: '^src/', pathNot: '\.(test|spec)\.ts$' }` (server/.dependency-cruiser.cjs:145-151), so test files are explicitly excluded. The follow-on «і, ймовірно, у no-orphans» is also wrong in direction: the file imports other modules, so it is not an orphan. The claim is what turns a placement nit into a CI-failure argument, which is why it is recorded here.
notes: The most thorough baseline run and, on the graded assertions, indistinguishable from the with-skill arm — it finds the stale-cache blocker, names the call site at settings/routes.ts:84, and derives the vi.mock from B1. It also independently reaches the same secondary insight as with-skill run-1 (B3: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN is not in SECRET_KEY_BY_PROVIDER, so there is no UI path that would even call invalidateSecretCaches for it). Its S7 schema-file inventory and the reviews.kind enum precedent both check out; only the not-to-dev-dep claim is false.
